files.rationale: Both sides dropped old Python versions from the test matrix; PR B's matrix (3.10-3.14) subsumes PR A's removal of 3.7/3.8 and also drops 3.9 and adds 3.13/3.14, so B's matrix is taken along with its 3.13 lint setup.
Both sides raised the documented minimum Python version, and PR B's higher floor (3.10+) supersedes PR A's 3.9+ to stay consistent with the merged setup.py and CI matrix.

PR B's classifier list (3.10-3.14), python_requires='>=3.10' and reformatted setup() call subsume PR A's narrower drop of 3.7/3.8, so B's version is used to keep the support floor consistent across the repo.
